prefill_prompt.text: Read the following notes and then answer the question at the end. The town library opens at nine in the morning on weekdays and at ten on Saturdays; it is closed on Sundays and public holidays. Members may borrow up to six books at a time for three weeks, and each loan can be renewed twice unless another member has reserved the book. Late returns cost twenty cents per book per day, capped at five dollars per book. The reading room on the second floor is reserved for quiet study, while the ground floor has a children's corner, two meeting rooms and a small cafe. Meeting rooms must be booked at least two days in advance at the front desk or on the library website, and bookings are limited to three hours. Printing costs ten cents per black and white page and fifty cents per colour page; scanning is free. Wireless internet is available throughout the building without a password, but the four public computers require a member card. Question: if a member returns two books four days late, how much do they owe, and can they book a meeting room for tomorrow morning?
